summary: Fundrise eREIT, LLC filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to announce a daily distribution for September 2026. The Manager declared a daily distribution of $0.0000684930 per share, equating to approximately 0.25% annualized at a $9.87 per share purchase price. Distribution period runs from September 1 to September 30, 2026, with payments scheduled before October 21, 2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or management change is involved. The filing is a routine declaration of distributions by a real estate investment trust. No board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics are included. Future distribution declarations are not guaranteed.
